title: Picture and text
description: A picture beside a heading, a text and a button — on the side of your choice; one under the other in a narrow column.

schema.label: Logo
schema.help: A small picture above the heading: a mark, a badge, a partner. Its text for screen readers is the one in the media library.

schema.label: Heading
schema.help: Two equals signs around words set them off in the accent colour: Homes ==by the river==.

schema.label: Button address (old)
schema.help: What this button had before it took a link. Used only while the link above is empty: choose the link, then clear this.

schema.label: Without animation
schema.help: Shown at once, even where the theme brings its blocks in as the page scrolls.

sample.heading: A picture and ==its words==
sample.body: Side by side on a wide screen, one under the other in a narrow column.
